# MonoForge — Complete AI Agent Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)
> https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app | Comprehensive schema, 22 modular plugins, 30+ SVG visualizations, 47 verified social platforms, and URL hydration instructions.

## 1. Zod Schema Specification (TypeScript)

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

export const UserSettingsSchema = z.object({
  github: z.string().default(''),
  name: z.string().optional().default(''),
  role: z.string().optional().default(''),
  bio: z.string().optional().default(''),
  location: z.string().optional().default(''),
  pronouns: z.string().optional().default(''),
  status: z.string().optional().default(''),
});

export const SettingsSchema = z.object({
  user: UserSettingsSchema.default({ github: '' }),
  theme: z.enum(['dark', 'light', 'auto']).default('dark'),
  accentColor: z.string().default('#f59e0b'),
  badgeStyle: z.enum(['for-the-badge', 'flat', 'flat-square', 'plastic']).default('for-the-badge'),
  align: z.enum(['left', 'center', 'right']).default('left'),
  includeAttribution: z.boolean().optional(),
});

export const SectionConfigSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  type: z.string(),
  title: z.string().optional(),
  visible: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
  props: z.object({
    content: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    styles: z.record(z.unknown()).default({}),
    state: z.string().optional(),
  }),
});

export const ReadmeConfigSchema = z.object({
  version: z.string().default('1.0.0'),
  title: z.string().default('MonoForge Profile'),
  settings: SettingsSchema,
  sections: z.array(SectionConfigSchema).default([]),
});

export type ReadmeConfig = z.infer<typeof ReadmeConfigSchema>;
```

## 2. 47 Official Verified Social Platforms

MonoForge includes 47 verified official brand SVG assets in `public/assets/icons/social/<platform>/default.svg`:
- **Development & Code**: `github`, `gitlab`, `codesandbox`, `codepen`, `devto`, `stackoverflow`, `visualstudio`, `leetcode`, `codeforces`, `codechef`, `tryhackme`, `kaggle`, `hashnode`
- **Design & Portfolio**: `behance`, `dribbble`, `unsplash`, `itch`
- **Networking & Socials**: `linkedin`, `twitter`, `x`, `bluesky`, `threads`, `mastodon`, `facebook`, `instagram`, `reddit`, `tiktok`, `linktree`, `medium`
- **Messaging & Community**: `discord`, `telegram`, `slack`, `signal`, `wechat`, `whatsapp`, `matrix`
- **Email & Productivity**: `gmail`, `outlook`, `microsoft-outlook`, `tutanota`
- **Media & Streaming**: `youtube`, `twitch`, `spotify`
- **Monetization & Funding**: `patreon`, `paypal`, `ko-fi`
- **Competitive & Assessments**: `hackerrank`

Each badge supports both icon mode (`format: "icon"`) and badge mode (`format: "badge"` with `for-the-badge`, `flat`, `flat-square`, or `plastic`).

Fetch the live JSON schema and field definitions from `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/api/schema`.
Registered plugin IDs in `website/src/lib/plugins/registry.ts`:
- `socials` — Verified social & sponsor pills
- `capsule-banner` — Animated SVG hero header banner

- `figma-design` — Figma showcase card

- `custom-html` — Sanitized Camo-safe HTML block

- `telemetry-engine` — Native telemetry card suite
- `telemetry-isocalendar` — 3D isometric contribution calendar
- `readme-typing-svg` — Kinetic typewriter SVG headline

- `github-profile-trophy` — Achievement trophy rack

- `skill-icons` — Tech stack icon matrix

- `waka-readme-stats` — WakaTime coding metrics
- `visitor-counter` — Profile view counter badge
- `portfolio-contributions` — 3D/2D contribution heatmap

## 4. URL Hydration & Deep-Linking

### Full Profile Config Hydration (`/en/developer?config=...`)
Encode a `ReadmeConfig` JSON payload using UTF-8 safe base64:
```javascript
const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(config));
const binString = Array.from(bytes, (b) => String.fromCodePoint(b)).join('');
const encoded = btoa(binString);
const url = `https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/developer?config=${encodeURIComponent(encoded)}`;
```

### Archetype Preview Deep-Link (`/en/templates?template=<id>`)
Share or open any of the 350+ archetypes directly:
```text
https://monoforge-studio.vercel.app/en/templates?template=01-minimal-professional
```

### Live User Personalization (`?user=<github_handle>`)
Pass `?user=<handle>` to `/en/developer?user=<handle>` or `/en/visualizer?user=<handle>` to pre-populate the target GitHub handle.
